==Comelle in the Third Age?==
Thoughts on Comelle as the ruins clinging to the cliffside that Rand sees on the march to Cairhien from the Waste? He asked Asmodean about it, who said it could be his home city (Shorelle) for all he knew, but this seems to fit the description.
